description: Seed registry for DimConcepts. 'name' is the canonical value for DimConcepts.concept_name. 'aliases' are surface forms mapped to it; unlike technologies there is no ConceptAlias table in schema.sql, so they widen prompt matching and are dropped at load time. 'parents' means 'knowing this implies knowing that' (dashboarding implies business intelligence), and loads into ConceptDependency as child_id -> parent_id; the graph is acyclic and a concept may have several parents. 'category' has no column, keep it or drop it at load time. Named products, tools and vendors do not belong here, they live in seeds/technologies.json: this registry holds what a posting asks you to know rather than what it asks you to operate. Spanish surface forms are aliases because the postings are mixed-language while the canonical name stays English.

concepts.name: authorization
aliases: control de acceso basado en roles

concepts.name: personal data protection law
aliases: ley de proteccion de datos personales
